title: Priority Queue
definition: A queue where each element has a priority. Elements with higher priority are dequeued before lower priority elements, regardless of insertion order. Usually implemented with a Min/Max Heap.
simpleExplanation: An Emergency Room waiting area. It doesn't matter who arrived first; the person with the most severe injury gets treated first.
